entities.name: Antiochia in Mesopotamia
entities.label: Place
entities.summary: Constantia or Konstantia was a town of some importance in the province Osrhoene in Mesopotamia, on the road between Nisibis and Carrhae, at no great distance from Edessa. It was, after his departure from Nisibis, the residence of the dux Mesopotamiae until the foundation of Dara.
